user.title: Add a monitoring location
user.description: MycoMonitor estimates how favourable conditions are for mushrooms to fruit. Its scores are explainable indices, not probabilities. Start with your first location; you can add more later.

data_description.name: How the location appears in Home Assistant, e.g. Urbasa.
data_description.location: The point to monitor. Weather data is fetched for these exact coordinates.
data_description.altitude: Optional. Leave empty to use the terrain height (90 m model). Temperatures are adjusted to this altitude.
data_description.habitats: Vegetation at the location. Species models (coming in 0.3) only run for compatible habitats.
